text: When the favourite was sent over to the race just as Holmes found him
why: Holmes says in ¶204 that he ran the horse just as it was sent over to him from the faker.
Holmes begins explaining to the Colonel at the racecourse (¶202–204).

text: Who is the faker in whose hands Holmes found the horse?
why: Holmes mentions a faker in ¶204, so asking who it is is a plain question. Silas Brown was already called a horse-faker in ¶148.
